{"script":"value="${var-}"
{
  echo "declare -p output:"
  declare -p var 2>/dev/null || echo "var not set"
  echo
  echo "export -p line (if exported):"
  export -p | grep -w '^declare -x var' || true
  echo
  echo "raw value (printf %q):"
  printf '%q\n' "$value"
} > var_snapshot.txt

num_type="non-numeric"
if [[ "$value" =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]]; then num_type="integer"
elif [[ "$value" =~ ^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]]; then num_type="float"
fi
{
  echo "runtime_type: shell-string"
  echo "numeric_indicator: $num_type"
  echo "has_sign: $( [[ "$value" =~ ^- ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
  echo "has_decimal_point: $( [[ "$value" == *.* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
  echo "raw_value: $(printf '%s' "$value")"
} > var_type.txt

error=""
parsed=""
fraction=""
if [ "$num_type" = "integer" ]; then
  parsed="$value"
  fraction="0"
elif [ "$num_type" = "float" ]; then
  read parsed fraction <<< $(awk -v x="$value" 'BEGIN{intpart=int(x); frac=x-intpart; printf "%s %s", intpart, frac}')
else
  error="not numeric"
fi
{
  echo "parsed_integer: $parsed"
  echo "conversion_error: $error"
  echo "fractional_remainder: $fraction"
} > parse_result.txt

{
  echo "Checks performed:"
  cat var_type.txt
  echo
  cat parse_result.txt
  echo
  if [ "$num_type" = "integer" ] && [ -z "$error" ] && { [ "$fraction" = "0" ] || [ -z "$fraction" ]; }; then
    all_passed=yes
  else
    all_passed=no
  fi
  echo "all_checks_passed: $all_passed"
} > decision_ready.txt

if [ "$num_type" = "integer" ] && [ -z "$error" ]; then
  printf 'yes'
else
  printf 'no'
fi
"}
